{"content":"import unittest

from bottle_song import recite


class BottleSongTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_default_single_verse(self):
        self.assertEqual(recite(10), [
            "Ten green bottles hanging on the wall,",
            "Ten green bottles hanging on the wall,",
            "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,",
            "There'll be nine green bottles hanging on the wall.",
        ])

    def test_last_two_verses(self):
        self.assertEqual(recite(2, 2), [
            "Two green bottles hanging on the wall,",
            "Two green bottles hanging on the wall,",
            "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,",
            "There'll be one green bottle hanging on the wall.",
            "",
            "One green bottle hanging on the wall,",
            "One green bottle hanging on the wall,",
            "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,",
            "There'll be no green bottles hanging on the wall.",
        ])

    def test_entire_song(self):
        lines = recite(10, 10)
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 49)
        words = ["Ten", "Nine", "Eight", "Seven", "Six", "Five", "Four", "Three", "Two", "One"]
        remaining = ["nine", "eight", "seven", "six", "five", "four", "three", "two", "one", "no"]
        for index, word in enumerate(words):
            with self.subTest(verse=word):
                offset = index * 5
                noun = "bottle" if word == "One" else "bottles"
                opening = f"{word} green {noun} hanging on the wall,"
                self.assertEqual(lines[offset:offset + 2], [opening, opening])
                self.assertEqual(lines[offset + 2], "And if one green bottle should accidentally fall,")
                noun = "bottle" if remaining[index] == "one" else "bottles"
                self.assertEqual(lines[offset + 3], f"There'll be {remaining[index]} green {noun} hanging on the wall.")
                if index < 9:
                    self.assertEqual(lines[offset + 4], "")

    def test_no_verses(self):
        self.assertEqual(recite(10, 0), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
","path":"test_bottle_song.py"}
